name: Chữ BUG · giấy vàng
description: Chữ BUG in sẵn trên mảnh giấy vàng/coral, không phải nhãn trống.

origin.prompt: One expressive text-bearing paper cutout. Exact text: BUG (three uppercase English letters only). Enormous energetic condensed black-purple ink brush-painted block letters, slightly imperfect printed texture, readable instantly, printed across an irregular vivid lemon-yellow paper silhouette cut closely around the word as one piece. Thin coral-red paper offset peeking beneath lower edge. Contemporary bold youthful Pop collage, tactile clean torn/cut paper, not sepia, not vintage newspaper, not a logo in a rounded badge. Wide aspect around 2:1. No other objects or words, no shadow. Actual transparent alpha outside entire piece, generous margins.
